summary: Research run 1 at simulator semantics 2.3.0 is finished and none of its 48 candidates can pass G1-G5; no file states that outcome. The paper/Demo candidate a01 has a pooled Validation mean of -0.1019 R on 613 trades.
expected: After the registered run, each candidate's G1-G4 status is computed and recorded with a decision reference.
actual: 45 candidates have a negative pooled Validation mean (fail G2 for certain), b16 fails G1 (fold 2 has 23 trades), a05 (+0.0027 R) and b12 (+0.0007 R) fail the bootstrap bound and Holm in every ordering tried. The figures sit in an evidence text file labelled reporting only; kill_gate_decisions.json has families: [].
impact: The roadmap proceeds without the fact that, under the project's own pre-registered rules, run 1 produced no acceptable candidate. No money at risk now. Protocol outcome, not a profitability forecast.
evidence: tmp/backtest_research_analytics/parse_v230.out and boot_sens.out; mean_r traced to src/research/run.py:762-786 and src/backtest/report.py:606-676 (pooled Validation, closed trades, net of costs).
reproduction: python -B parse_run.py <snapshot> 16-63-run-output.txt points_v230.json; python -B boot_sens.py points_v230.json 2000 (PYTHONPATH = snapshot)
why_tests_miss: No test or gate requires a status after a run; the report module prints no verdict by design.
recommendation: Record the per-family result with a decision reference; build the G2/G3 producer on kept trade lists; put the consequence to the owner.
known_prior: KNOWN:G3-004 for the missing gate code; outcome itself unrecorded. Independent confirmation of G-2101 (decisions_trading_soundness), whose 'significantly negative, z = -2.29' wording for a01 is overstated (iid z, not a protocol gate).

rule: RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 4 'Uncertainty reporting - required fields'; methodology gate 7
summary: The 240 committed experiment records hold only a trades digest; the trade lists were not kept; the G2 bootstrap interval is computed on every grid point and discarded before printing.
expected: A record, or a hashed file beside it, from which G1-G4 can be recomputed and checked against trades_digest.
actual: result_summary_json is {'trades_digest': ...} only. Per-candidate figures exist only in a hand-assembled text file bound to the records by no hash. The checkpoint directory with the trades (C:\rerun-v230\ck) no longer exists. src/research/report.py:61-73 drops expectancy_interval.
impact: No gate, including the real block-bootstrap bound, can be recomputed without a new simulation of about 25 hours on uncommitted raw data. A transcription error in the evidence file would be undetectable.
evidence: Record 0081eb04...json (3201 bytes) read in full; src/research/run.py:377-383, 762-786; src/research/report.py:22-23, 61-73; run output line 5.
reproduction: head -c 5000 of any record in docs/research/experiments/research-run-1-v2-3-0; list C:\rerun-v230
why_tests_miss: Tests pin the digest and the record schema, not the presence of the section 4 fields.
recommendation: Keep per-window trade lists (hashed, digest equal to trades_digest) as evidence and write the section 4 fields into a result file per candidate.
known_prior: B3-WR-02 added the digest; the missing fields are not in the registers read.

rule: D013/D030; RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 4 Kill gate D013
summary: The kill gate counts only family statuses a human chooses to record; with none recorded it returns WITHIN_BUDGET at any date, although three families were run.
expected: 'Three families tested' follows from the records of a registered run, or a finished run forces a recorded status.
actual: evaluate(families=[]) returns WITHIN_BUDGET with families_tested=0 on 2026-11-17, 2027-03-19, 2028-09-19 and 2036-09-19. LiveEnablementController.enable refuses only INSUFFICIENT_EDGE or an unevaluated state.
impact: The six-month kill gate (2027-03-19) will not fire on the present records; the state shown stays 'keep researching'. Live placement is separately disabled.
why_tests_miss: Tests feed the evaluator hand-built statuses; none starts from run records.
recommendation: Owner decision; then derive 'tested' from the experiment records of a completed authorized run, or require a status entry at run completion.
known_prior: Related KNOWN: WR-10, WR-12, WR-13 (kill_gate_review_registry.json), G3-004. The omission path is not among them.

component: simulator records vs live protective legs
rule: RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 3 exit ladder mirrors live; D046
summary: Take-profit legs are costed as a resting limit (slippage 1 bp) although live places TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET orders triggered by mark price; the stop, the same order class, is charged 3 bps.
expected: One slippage assumption for all market-type exits, or a stated reason for the lower one.
actual: records.py:151 'TP2 (a resting limit) uses expected_slippage'; placement.py:414,427 type TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET, working_type MARK_PRICE.
impact: Small bias in favour of every candidate, roughly 0.004 R on the mean (estimate), the size of the two positive means of run 1. Changes no verdict.
why_tests_miss: Cost tests pin the simulator's own rule.
recommendation: Owner decision; a change is a new simulator semantics version.

summary: G4 (drawdown at most 20 % of research equity on the pooled Validation equity curve) has no defined computation: the run prints an additive drawdown in R over four folds that each start at fresh equity 600.
expected: A written rule for pooling four fold ledgers into one equity curve and converting to percent.
actual: _max_drawdown sums R values; 20 % of equity is anywhere from about 40 R to 67 R, so 29 of 48 candidates cannot be decided on G4 from the printed figure.
impact: None on run 1; matters for a later run, where the rule would be chosen after results are visible.
recommendation: Fix the rule in a protocol amendment before any further run.
known_prior: KNOWN:G3-004 covers the missing code, not the definition gap.
